name: Sumii Hyouka
source: One of the three presidents of the Kitakoji Academy Student Association. She is a wealthy young lady. She is a genius and a brilliant person, but is easily bored. She is cool and high spirited. She leaves everything to her cronies except what she enjoys doing. She treats the protagonist, an incompetent man, as a trashy insect.
